search_text: published ZDI-22-538 ZDI-CAN-14615 (0Day) Epic Games Launcher Link Following Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2022-03-24 6.1 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:H ['Epic Games'] ['Epic Games Launcher'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Epic Games Launcher. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Epic Games installer. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the installer to delete a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
